texts.zh:
这个前超光速文明知晓了我们的存在。根据我们的政策 立场，我们目前能够采取有限的外交与行星的领袖接触。

我们的存在已在星球上公开，也就没有继续观测的必要了。我们的观测任务已终止。
texts.en:
The pre-FTL civilization knows of our existence. We can now engage in limited Diplomacy with the Planet's leadership, depending on our Policy stance.

With our presence made public to the planet, there is no longer anything to gain from observing the civilization. Our Observation Missions have been disabled.
